steps: Go to the official Chase offer page https://www.chase.com/personal/investments/offers/search and open the Self-Directed Investing account through that page by 10/21/2026.
Complete the application and get approved for the new account.
Transfer qualifying new money from OUTSIDE JPMorganChase (cash or in-kind securities) into the account within 45 days of opening — $5,000 minimum for the $50 entry tier.
Do not withdraw below your tier's qualifying amount: the bonus tier is determined on day 45 and funds must be maintained through day 90.
After all conditions are met, the bonus is added to the account within 15 days.
